answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond and names one knoll relay as origin; no knoll relay hosts more than 5 identities, so a farm must rent fresh relays. The k-th fake pays relay rent 20+5(k-1) above its bond: the 1000th pays 5015, and 1000 fakes lock 60000 plus 2517500 rent. A horizon audit panel re-checks origins against work logs each epoch; a relay whose identities share work logs forfeits every bond on it. A rented lagoon of look-alike relays fails because shared payout addresses re-link them into one cluster, slashed whole. An honest agent pays one 60 bond and one rent once.
